'''Wadie-platts''' were creatures [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Nim Drovis]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. They had luminscent [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that glowed in the dark. Wadie-platts occupied the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] and marshes of Nim Drovis.<ref name="pot" /> In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> when the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived on the planet along with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Bortrek]], their landing pad was surrounded by swamps filled with wadie-platts, [[gulper]]s, and [[Marsh-gunny|marsh-gunnies]].<ref name="pot" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wadie-platts first appeared in ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', a [[1997]] novel written by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="pot" />
